content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on qualifications Interview Shortlisted candidates will be communicated of the date of interview by email/phone

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Signed resume Aadhaar Card Voter Card/Pan Card SC/ST/OBC/Differently abled status along with self-attested photocopies of all documents/testimonials

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ISI Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Send a covering letter addressed to the Director of the Institute with current resume (signed). Include Name, Permanent Address, Corresponding Address, Telephone/Mobile No., Parent's/Spouse's Name, Date of birth, Academic Qualifications, Work Experience/Publications, CSIR/UGC NET or GATE score. Send via email to [email protected] with the subject line <NAME OF THE PROJECT>. Email it on or before 13 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: CVs with incomplete information or without supporting documents will be summarily rejected. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or joining the post. Original documents must be produced at the time of joining. The Institute reserves the right not to appoint any of the above.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 13 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on 13 November 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/Women/Differently abled Usual relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fixed pay of ₹37000 plus House Rent Allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Sc. or equivalent degree in Mathematics/Economics from recognised Institute or University with valid CSIR/UGCNET/GATE score.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Appointment will be until May 2027 from the date of joining with possible extension.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on qualifications. Interview. Shortlisted candidates will be communicated of the date of interview by email/phone.

faq.answer: Appointment until May 2027 from date of joining, may be extended later or terminated earlier.
